title: Drag Race 3D
description: Career-mode 1/4-mile drag racing. Buy and upgrade cars across 6 classes (E to Pro), tune launch RPM and gear ratios, paint your ride. 10 distinct tracks (stadium, urban, desert, neon night), procedural engine + shift audio, real-time shadows, weekly Race-of-the-Week leaderboard with ghost replays.
author: Nitzan
